scores.evidence: Triggered precisely when a user runs out of message credits in chat (m1, s03): 'When message credits are exhausted while chatting', offering +15 credits.
Appears at the zero-balance boundary, preserves user input, uses the Simula game partner ('Starship Galley'), and takes nothing away.
Restricted to non-paying users with a daily cap of 3 grants (max 45 credits/day, worth ~$0.06 vs $1.39 cheapest pack), backed by a 10% holdout.
Code-computed cost to serve is $0.0027 per view, well below US revenue per view ($0.0090–$0.0150).
Tied to the core messaging loop (m1 on s03, reach=core-loop), hitting active chatters frequently.
Uses standard SIM-RWD unit, button entry, REWARD_VERIFIED callback, and clean patch definitions.
Directly references digest items: economy resource 'r1', action cost 'k1', screen 's03', and game partner 'Starship Galley'.
Defines primary metric (Rewarded ARPDAU), guardrails (paid conversion, D7 retention, session length), and a 28-day user-level holdout.
